mapper.sql: id, event_type, scope, fp_id, fp_hash, headline, app_id, app_count, app_list, fp_count, exc_simple, exc_cause, severity, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, template_id, frame_list, total_count, trigger_reason, last_analyze_time, analyzed_total, analyzed_app_count, handled, handle_note, handler, handle_time, push_count, last_push_time, last_message_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = 0 AND fp_id = #{fpId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( fp_id = #{fpId} OR (template_id IS NOT NULL AND template_id = (SELECT template_id FROM ai_inspect_fingerprint WHERE id = #{fpId} AND deleted = 0)) ) ORDER BY handled ASC, last_seen_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = 0 AND template_id = #{templateId} AND scope <> 'LOCATION' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = #{handled} AND scope = 'LOCATION' AND template_id = #{templateId} AND app_id = #{appId} AND frame_list = #{frame} ORDER BY IF(#{handled} = 1, handle_time, NULL) DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_inspect_event (event_type, scope, template_id, fp_id, fp_hash, headline, app_id, app_count, app_list, frame_list, fp_count, exc_simple, exc_cause, severity, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, total_count, trigger_reason) VALUES (#{eventType}, #{scope}, #{templateId}, #{fpId}, #{fpHash}, #{headline}, #{appId}, #{appCount}, #{appList}, #{frameList}, #{fpCount}, #{excSimple}, #{excCause}, #{severity}, #{firstSeenTime}, #{lastSeenTime}, #{totalCount}, #{triggerReason})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event e WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.handled = 0 AND e.push_count > 0 AND e.last_message_id IS NOT NULL AND e.last_seen_time >= #{since} ORDER BY e.last_push_time DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = 0
ORDER BY last_seen_time DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_inspect_event SET last_analyze_time = #{analyzeTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT e.id, e.event_type, e.scope, e.fp_id, e.fp_hash, e.template_id, e.headline, e.app_id, e.app_count, e.app_list, e.frame_list, e.fp_count, e.exc_simple, e.exc_cause, e.severity, e.first_seen_time, e.last_seen_time, e.total_count, e.trigger_reason, e.last_analyze_time, e.handled, e.handle_note, e.handler, e.handle_time, e.push_count, e.last_push_time, e.last_message_id, e.create_time, e.update_time, e.deleted, l.template AS templateText, l.business_expected AS templateExpected FROM ai_inspect_event e LEFT JOIN ai_inspect_library l ON l.id = e.template_id AND l.deleted = 0
ORDER BY e.handled ASC, e.total_count DESC, e.last_seen_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalEvents, SUM(CASE WHEN handled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS openEvents, SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen_time >= #{todayStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayEvents, SUM(CASE WHEN first_seen_time >= #{todayStart} AND handled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayOpenEvents FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT app_id FROM ai_inspect_event WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' ORDER BY app_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_inspect_event e LEFT JOIN ai_inspect_library l ON l.id = e.template_id LEFT JOIN ai_inspect_fingerprint f ON f.id = e.fp_id SET e.handled = 1, e.handle_note = '模版归属已变更，已按当前模版重新聚合', e.handler = 'system', e.handle_time = NOW() WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.handled = 0 AND ( (e.template_id IS NULL AND f.template_id IS NOT NULL) OR (e.template_id IS NOT NULL AND (l.id IS NULL OR l.deleted = 1)) )

UPDATE ai_inspect_event SET handled = 1, handle_note = #{note}, handler = #{handler}, handle_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = 0 AND template_id = #{templateId}
AND event_type <> 'SURGE'

UPDATE ai_inspect_event e JOIN ai_inspect_library l ON l.id = e.template_id AND l.deleted = 0 AND l.business_expected = 1 SET e.handled = 1, e.handle_note = CONCAT('所属模版已确认为业务预期：', LEFT(COALESCE(l.reason, ''), 200)), e.handler = 'system', e.handle_time = NOW() WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.handled = 0 AND e.event_type <> 'SURGE'

UPDATE ai_inspect_event SET handled = 1, handle_note = CONCAT('系统自动收敛：连续静默至 ', DATE_FORMAT(#{quietBefore}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' 未再出现'), handler = 'system', handle_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND handled = 0 AND last_seen_time < #{quietBefore}
